name: team_dispatch
author: Flowork Sovereign Core
description: Protokol komando dan kolaborasi antar-rekan tim agen Flowork OS (Sovereign Swarm Protocol). Menginjeksi prompt estafet secara transparan ke sesi chat aktif menggunakan FLOWORK_CHAT_ID (UUIDv4) melalui Sovereign Switchboard Router. Dilengkapi Circuit Breaker (maksimal 3 turn chat inter-agent & anti-osilasi defek), Anti-Forgery identity binding, account_id affinity, dan Attestation Gate bukti Exit Code 0.
